reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is supported. The single member (supplier-warranty claim tracker, cop_18003cca096446f4a0db) has every link on EVIDENCE facts of its own record: a real purchase price ($79 paid by 54 shop owners in the 30 days to Nov 25, processor report), conversion measured on this offer's own page (54/1,800 = 3.0%), steady organic reach (1,800 uniques in 30 days, 55-65/day), Brain fulfils (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), $2 cost, $0 exposure, 2-day payout. Recomputed: 20 x $79 = $1,580 >= $1,500; ~60/day x 3.0% = 1.8 sales/day, so 20 sales by ~day 11-12 and settled by day 14 of 30; ~50 expected sales in the window gives 2.5x headroom, enough to absorb traffic decay of half. No capital: the $2 cost is netted from payouts, min cash 0. The ledger's four batches of 5 x $79 with 2-day settlement match the steps and the trace ($1,580 collected in window). The author correctly read buyer volume as 1,800 per 30 days, not per day as Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis states. The owner-taught course is correctly excluded: 10 owner hours of in-person work per course exceeds the ~8.6 hours the 2 h/week cap allows in 30 days, and the owner does no physical work.
findings: Recomputed: 20 sales x $79 = $1,580 gross, $40 direct cost, $1,540 net; proof day 14 of 30.

Owner hours are stated as 0 'Brain fulfils', but the card records humanHours 0.1; if per sale that is ~2 hours over the window, still inside the 2 h/week cap. Unknown or small hours are not zero; state 0.1/sale.

Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis reads 1,800 visitors per day (54,000 in window); the card says 1,800 per 30 days. The link still holds at the correct rate (~1,700 visitors in the remaining window, ~50 sales vs 20 needed).
Forward traffic is assumed to continue at the past 30 days' steady rate of new unique visitors from one pinned forum post; this is the main residual risk, covered by the 2.5x margin.
Operational note: SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; the plan sells via existing checkout so neither is on the critical path, but the checkout/payout must remain live.
